description: The bucket fisheye camera (1280x720) and its IMU: the one camera calibration every reader uses (policy.data.camera). Written by python -m policy.processing.camera_calibration; each section records its source recording and where the raw outputs are (results).

target.measured: 2026-09-27: tape, outer black edge to outer black edge across and down the grid, of aprilgrid.svg on a MacBook Pro screen (Chrome, device pixel ratio 2, grid 509.21 CSS px): about 3.75 in = 95.25 mm; uncertainty not specified. tagSize = grid width / 7.5.

intrinsics.method: OpenCV fisheye (pinhole-equidistant) fit to AprilGrid detections, 60 selected views

camera_imu.sign_convention: matching_imu_host_time = raw_camera_time + offset_s; omega_cam = R_cam_imu (omega_gyro - bias)
camera_imu.translation: not estimated; assumed 0 (camera and IMU on one rigid mount)
camera_imu.method: target poses (pose RMS <= 1.5 px) vs. the gyro integrated over the same ~100 ms intervals; fit on the first 60% of the moving segment, checked on the rest; gyro bias fitted with them, from the stillest 3 s window as the start
limitations: Camera-to-gyro timing and rotation only, not camera-to-IMU translation.
Host I2C read timestamps, rolling shutter and auto exposure remain sources of error.
The holdout is within one take, and the intrinsics are fitted on the same take.
